title: I Had To Fight For My Life Against My Own Shadow
cta: Tag a friend who is scared of their own shadow
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have turned around? Tell us in the comments.
lines: I had to fight for my life against my own shadow.
My mum has one rule. After sunset, never turn your back on your shadow.
Last night the power went out. One candle on the table.
I turned around to find the torch.
My shadow didn't turn with me.
It stayed on the wall, facing me. Then it smiled.
*It peeled off the wall and grabbed my ankle.
It dragged me toward the dark hallway. I clawed at the floor.
I grabbed the candle and shoved it into its face.
It shrank, hissing, back into the corner.
The lights came on. I was alive.
You see, the rule was never about it hurting you. It was about it taking your place.
Because Mum walked in, looked at me and screamed. I don't have a shadow anymore.
